headline: WNBA Semifinals locked: Aces and Liberty complete sweeps as final four emerges
whyCareReason: Historic clean sweeps across all four series set up a dream final four: Caitlin Clark's Fever meet top-seeded Minnesota, while the Aces and Liberty clash in a finals rematch.
teaser: Wednesday night finals: Aces 88-74 Wings, Liberty 80-76 Valkyries. All four Round 1 series end in 2-0 sweeps. Minnesota faces Indiana and Las Vegas battles New York.
story:
Why this one matters: Wednesday night brought a historic conclusion to Round 1 of the 2026 WNBA playoffs, as both remaining road favorites slammed the door on elimination Game 3s.

In Arlington, A'ja Wilson delivered an unstoppable 28-point, 13-rebound, four-block performance as the Las Vegas Aces pulled away from the Dallas Wings 88-74 to seal a 2-0 sweep. Kelsey Plum contributed 19 points, ensuring the defending champions reached the semifinals with minimal drama.

At Chase Center in San Francisco, the New York Liberty survived a fierce test against the expansion Golden State Valkyries, prevailing 80-76. Breanna Stewart led with 21 points and nine rebounds, while Sabrina Ionescu buried a decisive corner triple with 28 seconds remaining. For the first time in league history, all four opening-round series concluded in 2-0 sweeps, locking in a titanic final four: Minnesota vs Indiana, and Las Vegas vs New York.
stakes: The final four is locked: Minnesota Lynx vs Indiana Fever, and Las Vegas Aces vs New York Liberty.
rivalryAngle: Championship pedigree vs breakout power: Clark faces the No. 1 Lynx while Stewart and Wilson renew their historic rivalry.
